feature: A long edit plays, scrubs and edits without a stutter (pass 8)
summary: Cutting a clip you have picked (B) now costs about what a trim does: the piece the cut hands you lights up one frame after the cut instead of in the same frame, and ⌫ still throws that piece away straight after. The speed walk now times every edit both with nothing picked and with a clip picked.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The button on step 1 opens your own copy of the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev; once made, File > Open reaches it too (Cmd-Shift-G, ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Photonz Dev).

try.do: Open the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below, then click a clip on V1 so its sections fill the panel, then press Space to play.
While it plays over that clip, press B.
Press Space, then B again on the same clip, and watch the ring land on the piece before the cut.

evaluate: Does B on a picked clip feel as quick as a trim now?
After B, does Delete still throw away the piece before the cut, with no click in between?
Is the one frame between the cut and the ring round its piece something you can see?
rough: Bars still not reached on the 6 minute edit, so this task stays open. Worst of three short speed walks: trim 32, blade 77 with nothing picked (its first pick fills the panel), undo 41; with a clip picked, trim 34, blade 32, undo 44, against a bar of 16 ms. Scrub 2 frames behind (bar 1); 1 dropped frame a minute (bar 0).
Picking a clip still holds the window 38 to 46 ms, and the first pick fills the panel over about 450 ms in passes of 15 to 75 ms, one per section.

The undo of a cut still costs about 40 ms against about 20 for the undo of a trim: the clip going from two pieces to one. A Time Profiler run shows it spread through SwiftUI's own work, with no view of ours above 2 ms.

Until now the speed walk charged the edit after a cut for starting play again, which made the undo after a cut look about 20 ms worse than it is. Play now gets a second to start before the next edit is timed.
No mock covers this. It is speed work, and nothing on screen changed apart from when the piece's ring appears.
